fallback.header: NL This website provides EU citizens a way to provisionally ‘opt-out’ from the EHDS
fallback.intro: NL Our mission is provide all EU citizens with a means to object to being registred in the European Health Data Space (EHDS). Please in by clicking "Select Country"  if it is available for your country or checkout the the "about" button  for more info.

step1.title: NL With European Health Data Space (EHDS) you will lose control over who can access your medical records.
step1.intro: NL Your data can be used by researchers, governments, and commercial companies. You can object to this with an ‘opt-out’, for the two ways your data can be used.

step2.title: NL Select your GP
step2.intro: NL Next we will inform your GP about your choices and excersise you right to annonate your medical records. Also we will ask your GP to forward this to other healtcare institutions you may visit.
